findings.highlight: The answer her Master arrived at
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女のマスターが出した、傷だらけの答え
findings.governingReading: the answer her Master reached, itself covered in wounds
findings.explanation: The narration’s identification of Shirou’s answer with his wounded state is omitted.

findings.highlight: The anger she bore
findings.evidenceJa: 全身を支配していた怒り
findings.governingReading: the anger that had ruled her entire body
findings.explanation: Saber’s loss of bodily control to anger becomes ordinary possession of anger.

findings.highlight: With his ragged breath
findings.evidenceJa: ろくに目も見えず
findings.governingReading: unable even to see properly
findings.explanation: One of Shirou’s severe bodily impairments is omitted entirely.

findings.highlight: Controlling his tears
findings.evidenceJa: 流れる涙を懸命にかみ殺して
findings.governingReading: desperately biting back the tears running down his face
findings.explanation: The violent effort and already-flowing tears are weakened.

findings.highlight: the people I’ve left behind
findings.evidenceJa: 置き去りにしてきた物
findings.governingReading: what he has left behind
findings.explanation: The deliberately broad remains of Shirou’s past are again narrowed to people.

findings.highlight: I can’t stray from my path
findings.evidenceJa: 自分を曲げる事なんて出来ない
findings.governingReading: he cannot bend or betray himself
findings.explanation: Self-integrity becomes adherence to an abstract route.

findings.highlight: He has apologized to everything he has stepped on
findings.evidenceJa: 踏みつけてきたもの全てに頭を下げて
findings.governingReading: bowing his head to everything he has trampled underfoot
findings.explanation: A continuing embodied posture of acknowledgment becomes a completed verbal apology.

findings.highlight: he still declares that he will not change his path
findings.evidenceJa: 彼は道を曲げないと言い切った
findings.governingReading: he declares without qualification that he will not bend his way
findings.explanation: The source’s firmness and bending metaphor are weakened.

findings.highlight: she has also seen his
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女も彼の過去を共有した
findings.governingReading: she too had shared his past
findings.explanation: Mutual experiential sharing becomes detached observation.

findings.highlight: she, only able to deny his words, was wrong
findings.evidenceJa: 自分こそが、その道を間違えていた
findings.governingReading: she herself was the one who had mistaken that path
findings.explanation: Saber’s specific self-judgment about her chosen way becomes a generic verdict that she was wrong.

findings.highlight: you choose your wishes over your savior
findings.evidenceJa: 自らの救いではなく、自らの願いを取ったか
findings.governingReading: so you chose your own wish rather than your own salvation
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s contrast between self-salvation and desire is changed into choosing desire over a person who saves him.

findings.highlight: your wishes
findings.evidenceJa: 自らの願い
findings.governingReading: your own wish
findings.explanation: The singular defining wish is pluralized.

findings.highlight: use the Holy Grail to save the world
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯による世界の救罪
findings.governingReading: the world’s redemption/absolution through the Holy Grail
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s religiously charged “salvation from sin” becomes generic world-saving.

findings.highlight: will be as egotistical as that kid
findings.evidenceJa: 小僧のようにエゴはかざすまい
findings.governingReading: surely will not brandish ego as the boy does
findings.explanation: A provocative accusation about displaying self-interest becomes a stable personality label.

findings.highlight: Her heart is shaken
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の理性は揺さぶられた
findings.governingReading: Her reason is shaken.
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s argument destabilizes Saber’s rational judgment, not an unspecified emotional heart.

findings.highlight: She fought for that alone. She became a Servant for that reason alone.
findings.evidenceJa: その為だけに戦ってきた。その為だけにサーヴァントになったのだ
findings.governingReading: I fought for that alone; I became a Servant for that alone.
findings.explanation: The passage’s move into Saber’s first-person inner voice is flattened into external third-person narration.

findings.highlight: To obtain the Holy Grail, Saber
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯が手に入るのなら、私は
findings.governingReading: If I can obtain the Holy Grail, I—
findings.explanation: Saber’s interrupted first-person thought is recast as a detached narrator statement, weakening the interruption by Kotomine’s condition.

findings.highlight: She would do anything
findings.evidenceJa: 私は、どんな事だってやると決めた
findings.governingReading: I had decided that I would do anything.
findings.explanation: Saber’s prior conscious commitment loses both first-person ownership and the act of deciding.

findings.highlight: an unexpected proposal
findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも予想外の言葉
findings.governingReading: words far beyond anything she had anticipated
findings.explanation: The extremity of Saber’s shock is weakened.

findings.highlight: You can kill this kid before he realizes it
findings.evidenceJa: 死んだという事にも気が付かないうちに殺せる
findings.governingReading: you can kill the boy before he even realizes that he has died
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s grotesque claim that death would precede awareness loses its object.

findings.highlight: a collapsed figure
findings.evidenceJa: その奥で蹲る少年の姿
findings.governingReading: the boy crouched/huddled beyond the door
findings.explanation: Shirou’s identity, posture, and position beyond the doorway are generalized.

findings.highlight: he was shown his dark side
findings.evidenceJa: 自己の闇を見せつけられ
findings.governingReading: he was forced to confront the darkness within himself
findings.explanation: The coercive revelation of inner darkness becomes a stock moral label.

findings.highlight: She places her hands on her sword
findings.evidenceJa: 剣に手をかける
findings.governingReading: She puts a hand to her sword.
findings.explanation: The precise singular preparatory gesture is pluralized.

findings.highlight: At her feet is her Master, breathing painfully
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の主が倒れている
findings.governingReading: At her feet her Master lies fallen, breathing in pain.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s collapsed position is omitted at the point Saber reaches for her sword.
